taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Active Directory effective object control and delegated identity changes
controls.source_trace: Resolve the effective principal right on the exact object and trace it into a protected attribute, membership or credential operation.
controls.implementation_branch: Evaluate inherited ACE applicability, deny/allow semantics, group membership and protected-object behavior for the exact property/control right. GenericWrite and ownership/control rights can have different material effects. Read-only ACL exports can establish a delegation path, but a successful directory login or one permissive ACE alone does not prove arbitrary domain-wide control.
controls.operational_method: Resolve the object/property GUID, inherited-object type and inherit-only/applicability flags for each relevant ACE. Evaluate the actual token group set and effective descriptor, including protected-object inheritance behavior, before interpreting GenericWrite/ownership/control rights. Bind one permitted directory operation and one forbidden property/control right to that effective access decision. An isolated permissive ACE or membership display is not a complete domain-control path.
controls.controlled_verification: Use owned lab objects and synthetic principals or configuration-only proof; compare legitimate delegated management and a prohibited object/attribute.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: An ACE name without inheritance/group resolution is not effective control; read access or a denied write is not escalation.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Constrain delegation and inheritance while preserving intended administration, then verify actual allowed/denied rights.
